headline: Flagler complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Flagler closed their conference schedule by beating Georgia Southwestern, without a defeat and with North Georgia the only side to take a point from them. Their one loss all season came outside the conference, at Florida Southern in September.
displaced_by: truth: the standing dek's 'on Monday' now reads as today (2026-11-02), but the Georgia Southwestern win was on 2026-10-26. The headline story still holds, so only the dek's time reference is rewritten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fourteen different players have scored North Georgia's 41 goals, so their attack is spread across the squad rather than leaning on one scorer.

wire.line: Flagler went through the conference unbeaten, and North Georgia were the only side to take a point off them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 54 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 29 goals from 55 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored eleven of Flagler's 39 goals from 37 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored nine of North Georgia's 41 goals from 47 shots.

last_match.line: Clayton State have beaten Middle Georgia State every time the two have met this season, and go to North Georgia next.

next_match.line: USC Aiken arrive on a winning run, and Flagler have already beaten them home and away.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
